name: contract-document-reviewer
description: One skill: /contract-review. Attach a contract and, optionally, your firm's own playbook.md; the skill reviews it clause-by-clause against the playbook, flagging each clause GREEN, YELLOW, or RED with plain-English rationale and suggested redline language. Attorney reviews every rating and redline before it's used in negotiation. Assisted review, always reviewed — never decides whether to sign, negotiate, or reject a contract, and never sends, files, or executes anything.
